About Vidhan

Vidhan Raina is a 26-year-old singer from Jammu, a Kashmiri Pandit whose music carries the warmth of the valley wherever he performs. Today he lives in Delhi NCR and takes the stage across the region and beyond.

He is best known for Kashmiri Sufi, where devotion, poetry and melody meet, and for Bollywood favourites that bring a whole room to sing along. Each performance is shaped around the occasion and the people in the room, so it feels like an experience rather than a setlist.

  • RootsJammu, Kashmiri Pandit heritage
  • Based inDelhi NCR
  • Specialises inKashmiri Sufi and Bollywood
  • PerformsLive, solo or with a band
